title: Genesis 9:23-24 — Shem and Japheth cover their father; Noah awakes
summary: Genesis 9:23-24 in English: Shem and Japheth take a garment, lay it on both their shoulders, walk backward and cover their father's nakedness without looking; when Noah awakes from his wine he knows what his youngest son had done to him. The names Shem, Japheth and Noah and the word wine are colour-coded.

text.text: 23 But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it upon both their shoulders and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were turned away, so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
24 When Noah awoke from his wine, he knew what his youngest son had done to him.

keywords: Shem and Japheth covered their father
